title: Thermocatalytic synthesis of 2-butanol from biomass-derived levulinic acid using carbon-doped titania supported ruthenium
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01815J, Paper
Atina Sabila Azzahra, Rodiansono Rodiansono, Iryanti Fatyasari Nata, Kiky Corneliasari Sembiring, Indri Badria Adilina, Ahmad Afandi
The thermocatalytic synthesis of 2-butanol (2-BuOH) from biomass-derived levulinic acid (LA) using carbon-doped titanium dioxide supported ruthenium (denoted as Ru@C-TiO2) has been investigated systematically. The Ru@C-TiO2 catalysts were synthesised by...
